templates.connect_leader: Hi {first}, I'm an IT/IAM specialist in NJ automating Joiner-Mover-Leaver for 200+ users with Entra ID and AD, now going deep on SC-300. I admire the identity work at {company} and would love to connect and learn from you.
templates.connect_recruiter: Hi {first}, I'm an IAM-focused IT pro in Edison, NJ (Entra ID, AD, JML automation, AWS IAM, Security+). I saw {company} hiring for identity roles and would love to connect. US citizen, open to hybrid/remote.
templates.connect_expert: Hi {first}, your posts on identity have helped me a lot while I move from IT support into IAM (Entra ID, SC-300). Thank you for sharing. I'd love to connect and keep learning from you.
templates.follow_up: Thanks for connecting, {first}! Quick question: what skills do you see making the biggest difference for IAM engineers on your team right now? I'm building Entra PIM, access reviews and Graph automation labs and want to focus on what matters.
templates.hidden_jobs: Hi {first}, hope your week is going well. I'm actively looking for an IAM Analyst/Engineer role (Entra ID, AD, JML automation, AWS IAM). Are there any identity openings at {company} that aren't posted yet, or someone you'd suggest I talk to? Happy to share my resume. Thank you!
templates.referral: Hi {first}, I applied for the {job} role at {company}. My background: 4 years automating JML for 200+ users with Adaxes/Entra/AD plus AWS IAM admin and Security+. Would you be comfortable referring me or pointing me to the hiring manager? Thanks so much either way.
templates.group_intro: Hi everyone! I'm Amjad, an IT Support Coordinator in NJ moving into IAM. I automate Joiner-Mover-Leaver for 200+ users with Adaxes across AD, Entra ID and M365, and I'm studying for SC-300. Looking forward to learning from you all. What's one IAM skill you wish you'd learned earlier?

tips: Headline: "IAM Analyst | Entra ID · Active Directory · JML Automation · AWS IAM | Security+ | SC-300 in progress"
About: 3 short paragraphs: what you do (JML for 200+ users, least privilege, audit trails), proof with numbers, what you want next (IAM Analyst/Engineer, NJ/NY hybrid or remote).
Turn on Open to Work (recruiters only) with titles: IAM Analyst, IAM Engineer, Identity Engineer, Entra ID Engineer.
Skills: pin Microsoft Entra ID, Identity & Access Management, Active Directory. Add Conditional Access, PIM, PowerShell, SAML, Okta as you learn them.
Post once a week: a lab screenshot + 3 lines on what you learned (e.g., "Built my first PIM eligible role today"). Comment thoughtfully on 3 expert posts a week.
Send 5 connection requests a week with a personal note; follow up once after 7 days; never send more than one follow-up.
Featured section: link your best lab write-up or the Graph PowerShell script you built.
